stem: Four words are given. Three belong to the same logical class and one does not. Identify the odd one out: Violin, Sitar, Tabla, Cello.

per_option_rationale.rationale: Violin is a stringed instrument. It is played by bowing or plucking strings, matching the string instrument category.
Sitar is a stringed instrument (plucked). It belongs to the string instrument category.
Tabla is a percussion instrument (membranophone - a drum). Violin, Sitar, and Cello are all string instruments. Tabla is the odd one out.
Cello is a stringed instrument (bowed). It belongs to the string instrument category with Violin and Sitar.

explanation: Violin, Sitar, and Cello are all string instruments. Tabla is a percussion/drum instrument. The unifying property of three is being a string instrument; Tabla violates this and is the odd one out.

explanation_sections.punchline: Three are string instruments; Tabla is a percussion instrument.
explanation_sections.approach: Apply clues most-certain-first: classify each instrument by sound-production category. Violin = bowed strings, Sitar = plucked strings, Cello = bowed strings, Tabla = struck membrane (drum). The one from a different instrument family is Tabla.
explanation_sections.lesson: Musical instrument odd-man-out requires knowing the instrument family. Stringed (chord) instruments produce sound via vibrating strings; percussion instruments produce sound by striking a membrane or surface.
explanation_sections.timing: About 40 seconds. Trap: Sitar is an Indian instrument and Tabla is also Indian, so students may mentally group them together. The decisive criterion is sound production method, not cultural origin.
